name.help: Display name for this Slack communication channel.

webhook_url.help: Slack incoming webhook URL. Stored encrypted at rest.

title: Slack notification delivery
subtitle: Plugin-owned
description: This plugin owns the Slack. It stores the Slack webhook URL on the channel itself and dispatches notifications through the plugin runtime.
securityDescription: The webhook URL is stored encrypted at rest. Create a dedicated incoming webhook for McHarbor so it can be rotated independently.
testDescription: The host test action posts a real message to the configured Slack channel. Use a private test channel first if the webhook targets an on-call room.
secretKeepHint: Leave blank to keep the stored value.

step1.body: Open the target Slack workspace and create or choose the channel that should receive McHarbor notifications.

step2.body: Create a Slack app, enable Incoming Webhooks, add a webhook to the target channel, and copy the webhook URL.

step3.body: Paste the webhook URL into this channel configuration. McHarbor stores it encrypted at rest and redacts it from API responses.

step4.body: Save the channel and click Test connection. The plugin posts a real test message to Slack through the same path used for live workflow, alert, and backup events.

step5.body: If Test fails, verify the app still has incoming webhooks enabled, the webhook was not revoked, and the target channel still exists.
